schema.description: Read representation of a sandbox MID, returned once it is provisioned.

code.description: Code to identify the settings in the API/URLs/etc

name_en.title: Name [en]
name_en.description: Name to be displayed in dropdown or anywhere else the settings are being shown. IE: 'Knet' or 'Knet demo'

name_ar.title: Name [ar]
name_ar.description: Name to be displayed in dropdown or anywhere else the settings are being shown. IE: 'Knet' or 'Knet demo'

description.description: Optional description text that will be displayed alongside the payment method in the checkout SDK. Use this to provide additional context messages, or instructions to customers about this payment option.

is_active.title: Is active?
is_active.description: Designates if this object is active, can be used and displayed on site.

operations.description: Add operations that are available for this payment gateway.

payment_method_type.description:
Designates the type of payment method. Options include:


            - 'Flex': Indicates a flexible payment method such as 'Buy Now, Pay Later' (BNPL).


            - 'Redirect PG': Indicates a payment method that redirects to a payment gateway, such as a KNET payment URL.


            - 'OttuPG': Indicates a specific type of payment method.


            - 'Aggregator': Indicates a payment method that aggregates multiple payment options.


            - 'Click To Pay': Indicates a payment method that allows users to pay with a single click, typically used for saved payment methods or wallets.


            - 'ABA PayWay': Indicates a payment method that offers additional sub-options for customization, and their options will appear on the payment page.


            Note: If this field is left blank, the payment method will be considered as OttuPG or Redirect PG, depending on other factors.


            

* `bnpl` - BNPL
* `ottu_pg` - OttuPG
* `pg` - Redirect PG
* `aggregator` - Aggregator
* `click_to_pay` - Click To Pay
* `aba_payway` - ABA PayWay

plugins.description: Define plugins where this gateway settings will be available

tags.description: Business vertical tags for categorizing this payment method (e.g. e_commerce, pos, invoicing).

displayable.description: Disabling this flag will hide the PG payment method from the customer.To be used solely for payment services (Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, etc), when the payment service is under a different MID.

can_have_multiple_attempts.title: Allow Multiple Attempts
can_have_multiple_attempts.description: If disabled, the transaction will reach a final state upon receiving a callback and will not be re-attempted again.

is_tokenizable.title: Is Tokenizable?
is_tokenizable.description: Enable this flag to allow tokenization for this payment gateway.

auto_debit_enabled.title: Is Auto Debit Enabled?
auto_debit_enabled.description: Enable this flag to allow mid to perform auto debit operation.

form_fields.title: Form Fields Configuration
form_fields.description: Configure form field visibility and requirements for Jazz SDK and OttuPG hosted payment page. Example: {'name': {'display': true, 'required': true}}
